title: GZCLP – Day 2 (B1)
creator: Cody Lefever (GZCL)
description: Cody Lefever's linear-progression entry to the GZCL method: each session has a heavy T1 lift (5×3, last set AMRAP), a moderate T2 lift (3×10) and a T3 back accessory (3×15, last set AMRAP). Four workouts rotate over three days a week (A1, B1, A2, B2, A1…), adding 2.5 kg to upper and 5 kg to lower lifts each time a lift comes round. When you miss the rep target, keep the weight and drop a stage: T1 5×3+ → 6×2+ → 10×1+ then retest a 5RM; T2 3×10 → 3×8 → 3×6 then restart heavier; T3 adds weight at 25 AMRAP reps.

items.name: T1 overhead press 5×3+
items.note: T1: +5 lb / 2.5 kg (press) or +10 lb / 5 kg (squat, deadlift) per workout; miss the reps → same weight, next stage (6×2+, then 10×1+)

items.name: T1 overhead press 5×3+ – AMRAP
items.note: AMRAP set (stop 1–2 reps short of failure; cap at 10 reps)

steps.note: 3+ reps: as many as possible with good form; Rest 3–5 min

items.name: T2 deadlift 3×10
items.note: T2: same increments per workout; miss 30 total reps → same weight, next stage (3×8, then 3×6)

items.name: T3 dumbbell row 3×15+
items.note: T3: add weight once the AMRAP set reaches 25 reps

steps.note: 15+ reps: as many as possible with good form; Rest 60–90 s
